slides.text: That is how many kinds of amino acids build every protein in your body. Like LEGO bricks in 20 colours.

slides.title: Short chain = peptide
slides.text: A few up to about 50 linked amino acids make a peptide. A longer, folded chain is called a protein.

slides.title: A sweetener made of two amino acids
slides.text: Aspartame is a derivative of a dipeptide, two amino acids joined together.
